UPSSSC Ayurvedic Pharmacists 2024 Eligibility Result 2026 - Complete Details

Short Information : Uttar Pradesh Subordinate Services Selection Commission (UPSSSC) has released a Eligibility Result for the recruitment of Ayurvedic Pharmacists on its official website. This recruitment has been announced for a total of 1002 posts. The online application process for UPSSSC Ayurvedic Pharmacists Recruitment 2024 were accepted from 12 February 2024, to 03 March 2024. Candidates are advised to check the complete details for UPSSSC Ayurvedic Pharmacists 2024 Eligibility Result 2026 given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 12 February 2024
  • Last Date : 03 March 2024
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 03 March 2024
  • Correction Last Date : 11 March 2024
  • Eligibility Result : 28 July 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Soon
  • Admit Card Available : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, EWS, OBC : Rs. 25/-
  • SC, ST, Candidates : Rs. 25/-
  • PH Candidates: Rs. 25/-
  • Candidates have to pay their Examination Fee Through Debit Card / Credit Card / Net Banking / UPI and Other Fee Payment Mode Only.

How to Check Result

  1. Visit the official website.
  2. Click on the result / scorecard link.
  3. Enter your application number / roll number and date of birth / password.
  4. Click on submit to view your result.
  5. Download and take a printout of the scorecard for future reference.
